title: "Pilot 6 - Parents' access to data"
linkTitle: "Pilot 6 - Parents' access to data"
weight: 60
status: "New"

---
Pilot 6 concerns giving parents and guardians simple and clear access to data that are relevant for following the pupil's development, such as national tests, assessments, final assessments and grades. Today there is no single place for this, and parents have to find and piece together the information from many sources themselves.
